patch.summary:
Choose folk only if your buying job matches “Simple relationship CRM for organizing contacts and collaborative outreach.” rather than Salesforce Account Engagement's shape. Choose Salesforce Account Engagement only if your buying job matches “Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) B2B marketing automation — Salesforce-native nurtur” rather than folk's shape. Workflow advantage: folk leans contact-management, relationship-management; Salesforce Account Engagement leans lead-management, sales-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: folk is Simple relationship CRM for organizing contacts and collaborative outreach.; Salesforce Account Engagement is Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) B2B marketing automation — Salesforce-native nurture and lead management via custom quote; CRM-primar.
- Workflow coverage skew: folk-leaning contact-management, relationship-management, email-outreach vs Salesforce Account Engagement-leaning lead-management, sales-automation, inbound-sales.
- Researched limits: folk — Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.; Salesforce Account Engagement — MA product — pairs with Salesforce CRM rather than replacing it.

Limitations — folk: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.; Enrichment, magic fields, and AI assistant credits are monthly capped by plan (custom on Enterprise).; Salesforce Account Engagement: MA product — pairs with Salesforce CRM rather than replacing it; Custom quote / Salesforce packaging.

Poor-fit cases: folk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium. · Salesforce Account Engagement is a poor fit when that limitation bites: MA product — pairs with Salesforce CRM rather than replacing it · Avoid folk if you actually need Salesforce Account Engagement's motion (Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) B2B marketing automation — Salesforce-nat)
